name: LUMEN
body: A camera that finds light where there is none. No flash. No compromise.
features: Computational capture down to 0.02 lux. No flash, no noise, no excuses.
Locks in twelve milliseconds and tracks faces through total darkness.
Nine looks calibrated by colourists. Not filters, not luck.
product_body: A full-frame sensor, a new image pipeline, and an interface that gets out of the way.
